title: NBN POI 4CAB (CABOOLTURE) 4IPS (Ipswich) NNI Rehoming
current_summary: Planned works on our network will rehome NBN services connected via the Caboolture (4CAB) and Ipswich (4IPS) points of interconnect in Brisbane to a new router. Customers on these POIs may experience brief interruptions during the window from 12:00 AM to 2:00 AM AEST on 13 August 2026. Services are expected to restore automatically after the work, and our team will be monitoring throughout.

updates.content: We will be performing planned network works affecting some NBN services connected via the Caboolture and Ipswich points of interconnect in Brisbane. The maintenance window is 12:00 AM to 2:00 AM AEST on 13 August 2026. During this time, services on these POIs may briefly drop as we move connections to a new router. Any affected services should come back online automatically. We will keep interruptions to a minimum and will monitor progress throughout. Thank you for your patience.
